name: deferred_loop_from_scratch
description: G-5, story B, with T-1's defaults: a deferred material loop built from a Blank pipeline with Studio alone. New Project (F-2) proposes the name; a Cube turned 45 degrees about the vertical, typed as one angle, so two faces meet the camera, and a Floor from Add Object (G-2 / T-1). On Blank's graph root the Frame Plan's Add material pass... is the Graph's palette (GL-5c): deferred_geometry_v1 with its five G-buffer images and depth in the graph's nodes. Add fullscreen pass... places the palette's render.fullscreen on the Graph and picks it; its Pass fields' New... > Deferred lighting (G-3) writes the template and puts it on the pass with Uses scene lights, Camera position and a line from each G-buffer output (UX-5a). Its colour output dragged onto present's + input is shown through the Blank pipeline's engine://passthrough (VI-2). The light paints the two faces in different colours; turning the light in the Inspector changes them.
